row.evidence: The pricing page lists SSO as an optional add-on on Start and Advance and included on Optimize but never mentions SCIM; a Tellent help article refers to organizations that use "automated user provisioning (SCIM)" without documenting it for Recruitee.
row.notes: Status unchanged (unknown). Rebranded as Tellent Recruitee (part of the Tellent suite with Tellent HR). Tier names Start, Advance and Optimize are unchanged, but no prices are published (every tier is 'Get a demo'); June's '~EUR 199-301/mo' has no first-party source and is dropped. SSO (SAML2) is an optional add-on on Start and Advance and included on Optimize (June: Optimize only). A Tellent admin-access article mentions SCIM provisioning for Tellent organizations, and the 2025 Tellent roadmap planned Okta SCIM for Q4, but no SCIM setup guide, endpoint or plan exists for Recruitee; the only SCIM guides found are for Javelo (another Tellent product). SSO adds coworkers who have the IdP app assigned (JIT-style), but removal needs revoking in the IdP and deleting in Tellent. The ATS API (personal bearer tokens with the user's permissions) has admin, invitation and membership endpoints; its plan is not stated (pricing lists 'API access').

limitations.text: A Tellent help article says that under automated user provisioning (SCIM), deactivating the last admin is blocked; no Recruitee SCIM setup guide was found.
Tellent's 2025 roadmap listed Okta SCIM for Q4 2025; delivery for Recruitee is not confirmed.

auth.notes: Tokens carry the generating user's permissions; no scoping.

capabilities.notes: Team members are 'memberships'; invitations take a role_id. delete_user = bulk membership removal.

endpoints.purpose: Invite team members in bulk (email, role_id, offer_ids)

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/recruitee/, /tellent/ and /tellent-recruitee/ return 404; Tellent documents Okta SAML setup.
